_comment: Vol 22 (Wicker Park / Bucktown, ~1200-2600 W, 800-2500 N) -> modern renames. VOLUME-SCOPED. Source: 'Chicago Streets', William Martin 1948 (CHM street-name-changes list, http://chsmedia.org/househistory/nameChanges/start.pdf, accessed 2026-07-25). Each entry was spot-checked against the sheets; HAMBURG->SHAKESPEARE (not Fullerton) and FOWLER->SCHILLER (not Hermitage) and ALICE PL->CONCORD (not Belden) disambiguated on-sheet. MC HENRY covers the spaced read; MCHENRY the joined one.
_comment2: Deliberately NOT aliased: BLANCHE (LeMoyne's stretch sits outside the volume bounds). N. LINCOLN (-> Wolcott 1936) CANNOT be aliased here: modern Lincoln Ave enters the volume bounds, so the key would collide (twin rule); those reads false-match Lincoln Ave today.
